declare
v_local_time date;
v_local_date date;

BEGIN
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 v_local_date := v_local_time;
 else
 v_local_date := sysdate;
 end if;


 SELECT contract_type , code_desc into :ctrl_blk_1.contract_type,
 :ctrl_blk_1.contract_name
 FROM contracts A , master_codes B
 WHERE chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_1.chapter_id 
 AND contract_id = :ctrl_blk_1.contract_id 
 AND contract_type = code 
 AND code_type = 'CONTR' 
 AND v_local_date between A.eff_date AND nvl(A.term_date,v_local_date+365) 
 AND v_local_date between B.eff_date AND nvl(B.term_date ,v_local_date+365) ;
 
 EXCEPTION 
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN 
 show_error('1147');
 check_package_failure;
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
END;

BEGIN

 -- temp_c_dummy := to_number(substr(:ctrl_blk_1.coll_id,2,4)); 
 
 -- IM# 5438

 into l_count
 from dual;

-- select count(*) into nCount from valid_collection_agencies where

 Begin
 
 SELECT contract_id 
 INTO temp_v_contract_id 
 FROM valid_collection_agencies 
 WHERE chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_1.chapter_id 
 AND coll_id = :ctrl_blk_1.coll_id 
 and contract_id = :ctrl_blk_1.contract_id;

 EXECUTE_QUERY(NO_VALIDATE);

 Exception

 from valid_collection_agencies
 where chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_1.chapter_id 
 and coll_id = :ctrl_blk_1.coll_id 
 and v_local_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date,v_local_date+1);

 Else

EXCEPTION

ProgramUnit.Name: POP_CONTRACT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE pop_contract(pl_coll_id in varchar2) IS
v_msg varchar2(300);
v_local_time date;
v_local_date date;

 cursor cont_cur(p_local_date in date) is select contract_id,company contract_name from contracts where
 contract_id in (select distinct contract_id from valid_collection_agencies where coll_id=pl_coll_id and
 p_local_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date,p_local_date+1)) and
 p_local_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date,p_local_date+1);


BEGIN
begin
 select error into v_msg from valid_errors_lab where error_code='9800';
exception when others then 
 v_msg:='Confirm the COLLID:';
end;

 :ctrl_blk_1.warning_msg:=v_msg;
 go_block('ctrl_blk_2');
 
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 v_local_date := v_local_time;
 else
 v_local_date := sysdate;
 end if;


 FOR Z in cont_cur(v_local_date) Loop
 :ctrl_blk_2.c_contract_id:=Z.contract_id;
 :ctrl_blk_2.c_contract_name:=Z.contract_name;
 next_record;
 END Loop;
 first_record;
 go_item('ctrl_blk_1.yes_no');
 synchronize; -- Added by Kishore on 09/18/2012. IM 9004
END;
